quote: Oh, I’ve never forgotten for long at a time that living is struggle.
source: Thornton Wilder, The Skin of Our Teeth, Act III, near the end (Mr Antrobus) (Harper and Brothers, 1942)
speaker: Mr Antrobus

evidence.where: HathiTrust full text phrase search on Oh, I’ve never forgotten for long at a time returned The Skin of Our Teeth: Play in Three Acts by Thornton Wilder, and the same for never forgotten for long at a time that living is struggle. Wikiquote prints the surrounding speech, assigns it to Antrobus in Act Three, and continues I know that every good and excellent thing in the world stands moment by moment on the razor edge of danger.
evidence.edition: The Skin of Our Teeth: A Play in Three Acts (Harper and Brothers, 1942)
evidence.locator: Act III, Antrobus back at home in Excelsior near the close

reason: Two independent phrase searches inside the printed play carry the opening Oh and the rest of the sentence, and a quotation source places it in Act III in Antrobus’s closing speech. It is a full sentence and ends in a stop.
